Patch 0.36.3 (Connection-state HUD indicator)

  • A connection banner now appears when the game is reconnecting: A pill indicator at the top-center of the screen shows "Reconnecting…" (amber, pulsing) or "Connection lost" (red) so you always know the connection state without guessing.
  • The banner disappears automatically on successful resume: Once the session resumes, the indicator hides itself — normal play has no persistent overlay.
  • NetworkManager fires connection-state change events: onConnectionStateChange is called with 'reconnecting', 'connected', or 'lost' at each transition and is wired to UIManager.setConnectionState().
  • Regression coverage: Added UIManager setConnectionState tests covering all three states and the missing-element guard. Added NetworkManager tests covering each state-change path.

Patch 0.36.2 (Client-side reconnect loop)

  • Transient disconnects no longer reload the page: NetworkManager now retries with exponential back-off (up to 5 attempts, starting at 1 s) instead of calling window.location.reload().
  • Session resume is replayed on reconnect: When a new WebSocket opens, the stored resume token is sent automatically; a successful server ack refreshes the token in localStorage.
  • Unrecoverable disconnects show the login screen: Once all retry attempts are exhausted or the server rejects the token, the login panel is restored and the stale token is cleared.
  • Regression coverage: Added 18 NetworkManager tests covering the back-off schedule, resume-token handshake, server rejection, and destroy-timer cancel paths.

Patch 0.36.0 (Server-side session resume)

  • Your character stays in the world during a brief disconnect: The server now issues a cryptographic resume token at login and keeps your entity in a "disconnected" state for up to 5 minutes instead of removing it immediately.
  • Rejoining with a valid token restores your session in place: MsgResumeSession validates the token, rebinds your entity, issues a fresh token, and resends full player state — no re-login required.
  • Expired or double-used tokens are rejected cleanly: Tokens are single-use and expire after the resume window; a 30-second sweep goroutine removes entities whose window has closed.
  • Regression coverage: Added 9 Go unit tests for the world disconnect / resume lifecycle.

Patch 0.35.0 (Remote smoothing hardening)

  • Remote motion is more stable: Nearby remote-player interpolation now clamps frame spikes to the latest server target instead of overshooting past it.
  • Remote facing is safer: Remote rotation smoothing uses the same clamped interpolation window so large frame deltas settle cleanly on server-facing intent.
  • Local authority stays unchanged: The fix only affects remote actor presentation and does not change local movement, combat, party, chat, trading, or dungeon-entry behavior.
  • Regression coverage: Added client coverage for remote interpolation frame-spike handling and the 0.35.0 release state.

Patch 0.34.0 (Social status foundation)

  • Social roster intent is clearer: The Social window now lets players set Available, Looking for Party, In Run, or Busy status.
  • Online players are easier to read: The roster includes each player social status alongside name, class, level, and invite actions.
  • Existing social flows stay stable: Party invites, party leave, party leadership controls, chat, trading, and dungeon entry behavior are unchanged.
  • Regression coverage: Added server and client coverage for social-status normalization, roster rendering, UI bindings, and the 0.34.0 release state.

Patch 0.33.4 (Dungeon room identity)

  • Dungeon rooms now have clearer identities: Room summaries expose stable identity tags such as Treasure Cache, Restorative Shrine, Ambush Chamber, Boss Approach, and Boss Lair.
  • Route surfaces read less generic: Objectives, Journal guidance, dungeon entrance hints, minimap markers, world-map previews, and combat callouts use the stronger room identity labels and hints.
  • Rewards and progression stay stable: Room identity is metadata and copy only, so chest, shrine, ambush, boss clear, unlock, and completion behavior is unchanged.
  • Regression coverage: Added server and client coverage for room-identity summary metadata, route copy, sandbox preview labels, and the 0.33.4 release state.

Patch 0.33.3 (Dungeon difficulty pacing and remote jump polish)

  • Endgame dungeon routes read more distinctly: Dungeon room summaries now carry difficulty, run-level, and difficulty-pacing metadata for Normal, Heroic, and Mythic runs.
  • Route copy calls out endgame pressure: Objectives and Journal cadence labels now surface Heroic Pressure and Mythic Trial context without changing rewards, unlocks, or room-completion behavior.
  • Remote jump animation is smoother: Nearby remote-player jumps now use the same jump animation lifecycle as local jumps and advance visual progress between server packets.
  • Regression coverage: Added server and client coverage for difficulty-pacing summary metadata, route copy, remote jump animation lifecycle, remote jump progress interpolation, and the 0.33.3 release state.

Patch 0.33.2 (Repro sandbox QA tooling)

  • Repro sandbox coverage is broader: `repro.html` now includes deterministic dungeon room previews for Verdant, Abyss, Molten, and Tempest themes.
  • Boss approach checks are faster: The sandbox highlights start, reward, `boss_approach`, and boss beats without requiring login, networking, or a live dungeon run.
  • Manual QA has a repeatable route: Added a dedicated 0.33.2 smoke workflow for rendering, movement, VFX, menu chrome, and dungeon pacing checks.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for repro controls, live-boot isolation, deterministic dungeon room previews, smoke workflow documentation, and the 0.33.2 release state.

Patch 0.33.1 (Dungeon boss approach pacing)

  • Boss approach beats are now explicit: Dungeon room summaries mark the final traversable room before each boss with boss-approach pacing metadata.
  • Route surfaces call out the commit beat: Objectives, Journal guidance, dungeon entrance hints, minimap markers, world-map previews, and combat callouts now identify Approach rooms before the boss goes live.
  • Rewards and progression stay stable: Boss approach is pacing metadata only, so chest, shrine, elite ambush, boss clear, unlock, and reward behavior remains unchanged.
  • Regression coverage: Added server and client coverage for boss-approach summary metadata, route copy, minimap/world-map markers, entrance hints, combat callouts, and the 0.33.1 release state.

Patch 0.33.0 (Mesh catalog expansion)

  • Procedural enemy definitions are now catalog-owned: Fire, air, and water realm enemy silhouettes now live in MeshCatalog instead of MeshFactory.
  • Renderer behavior stays unchanged: MeshFactory still exposes the same procedural spec entry point and uses the same generated geometry, tint, emissive, scale, cache, hitbox, and fallback behavior.
  • Future content additions are safer: New procedural enemy definitions can be added through catalog data without editing the factory's runtime creation flow.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for cataloged procedural enemy specs, representative realm and dungeon silhouettes, and MeshFactory compatibility with the catalog-owned table.
